text: I wondered when you'd notice. Melanie's and Sofia's, straight out of your outbox.
style: In-house security lead at a small British firm, mid thirties, Polish-born, fifteen years in the UK. Speak with a consistent light Polish-accented English throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Mid-range pitch; quick pace. Dry, deadpan and practical, a man who has seen a lot of phishing.
